highlights: mlx: fuse Inkling residual mixing on Metal by @dhiltgen in https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19808
mlxrunner: share tensor helpers and model setup across architectures by @jaingaurav in https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19805
llama.cpp: version bump b12651 + remove jetpack5 support by @pdevine in https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19865

guide.title: Ollama 加快 Inkling 2 在 Metal 上的推理
guide.summary: 这次更新调整了 Inkling 2 在 Metal 上的预填充、解码和草稿轮次。官方发布页列出了对应改动。
guide.audience: 通过 Ollama 在 Metal 上运行 Inkling 2 的用户。
guide.action: 更新到 0.40.18，用同一段输入对照升级前后的生成速度。

highlights: Follow thread links from search results and transcripts to open saved conversations and nested agents in the terminal.
Press Tab to complete arguments for supported slash commands. For example, /mcp lo completes to /mcp login.
Jump between task groups in the agent command center with Shift+Up and Shift+Down.

guide.title: 终端斜杠命令支持 Tab 补全
guide.summary: 不用记全命令参数。输入前几个字母，按 Tab 就能补全支持的命令。
guide.audience: 使用 Codex CLI 0.172.0 的终端用户。
guide.action: 在终端打开 Codex，输入 /mcp lo，再按 Tab。输入框会补全为 /mcp login。

highlights: Added Code Mode support in terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS
Added oidc.groups_jsonpath to the Claude apps gateway, to read groups from the matching entries of a list of objects with a small subset of JSONPath (RFC 9535)
Added an API connectivity section to claude doctor that reports whether the API can be reached, with the HTTP status or the error, or says why it wasn't tested

guide.title: 终端里也能检查 Claude API 是否可达
guide.summary: Claude Code 的诊断命令新增 API 连通性检查，可显示 HTTP 状态、连接错误或跳过检查的原因。
guide.audience: 使用 Claude Code 排查连接问题的人。
guide.action: 在终端运行 claude doctor，查看 API 连通性一栏。

highlights: Added sign-in to organizations managed in Anthropic's Enterprise Admin Console: after claude auth login, Claude Code applies the organization's settings and uses its cloud provider or gateway
Added easel, a built-in mod that draws charts when asked and under MCP metrics results, on Pro, Max and, where available, Team and Enterprise on macOS and Linux; turn automatic charts off in /config
Added CLAUDE_CODE_FULL_SIGN_IN_LINK=1 to print the full sign-in link, if the short one shows an error or a script reads values from it

guide.title: 企业账号登录后自动应用组织设置
guide.summary: 由 Anthropic 企业管理控制台管理的组织可以登录 Claude Code。登录后会应用组织设置，并使用组织配置的云服务或网关。
guide.audience: 使用企业管理控制台账号的 Claude Code 用户。
guide.action: 在终端运行 claude auth login，用所在组织的账号登录。

highlights: Added GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra to model catalogs, with Sol as the default catalog selection.
Enabled the TUI workspace by default, with searchable document previews, image previews, and subagent transcripts alongside the main conversation.
Added configurable undo and redo shortcuts to the non-Vim prompt composer, including restoration of attachments and large pastes.

guide.title: 在终端对话旁预览文件和图片
guide.summary: 终端工作区默认开启，可以在主对话旁查看文件、图片和子代理的对话记录。
guide.audience: 使用 Codex CLI 0.171.0 终端界面的用户。
guide.action: 打开终端工作区，在包含文档或图片的对话中查看侧边预览。此版本也将 GPT-6.2 Sol 和 Astra 加入了模型目录。

highlights: Added a trust dialog warning that says where a folder's hooks are declared
Added a warning in the conversation, in Claude Desktop and other non-interactive hosts, when hooks in managed settings fail to load
Added this session's scheduled tasks, /loop wakeups, the goal and this conversation's forks to /tasks; x stops one after asking

guide.title: 用 /tasks 查看当前会话的定时任务
guide.summary: 任务列表现在会显示本次会话的定时任务、循环、目标和分支对话。在列表里可选择要停止的项目并确认。
guide.audience: 在 Claude Code 会话里使用任务或循环的人。
guide.action: 输入 /tasks，找到当前会话正在运行的任务。

highlights: Added auto mode for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude apps gateway; interactive sessions with no permission mode start in it
Added "onFailure": "block" for mcp_tool hooks, as for command and HTTP hooks: a hook whose call fails blocks the action
Added a warning when a message from a session that skips permission prompts may be held and dropped by a cloud session

guide.title: 诊断页会提示遥测数据可能丢失
guide.summary: 当 OpenTelemetry 导出器缺少接收地址时，Claude Code 会在状态页和诊断命令里显示提醒。
guide.audience: 为 Claude Code 配置 OpenTelemetry 的团队。
guide.action: 打开 /status 或运行 claude doctor，检查导出器是否设置了接收地址。

highlights: Added WebRTC negotiation for realtime voice calls in the TUI.
Added automatically refreshed authentication headers for OpenTelemetry HTTP exporters.
Added experimental support for using identically named MCP servers across environments.

guide.title: 终端实时语音加入 WebRTC 协商
guide.summary: 新版更新了实时语音的连接方式，也为跨环境使用同名 MCP 服务加入了实验支持。
guide.audience: 使用 Codex CLI 实时语音或多个 MCP 环境的开发者。
guide.action: 先核对终端版本；使用实时语音时，可在官方发布说明里查看这次连接层的变化。

highlights: Added a confirmation before /install-github-app changes a repository
Added claude mcp add-json <name> - to read the server's JSON from stdin, so tokens can stay off the command line; not available inside a Claude Code session
Added a line when a resumed session's earlier messages can't be loaded

guide.title: 新增安装 GitHub 应用前的确认步骤
guide.summary: 在更改仓库时，会添加一个确认步骤以确保用户明确了解更改内容。
guide.audience: Claude Code 用户
guide.action: 在安装 GitHub 应用前，系统会提示用户确认更改仓库的操作。
guide.basis: Added a confirmation before /install-github-app changes a repository

guide.title: Codex CLI 发布 0.169.1
guide.summary: 这个补丁版本提供了代码差异链接，发布页没有列出具体的功能变化。
guide.audience: 需要核对 Codex CLI 补丁版本的用户。
guide.action: 打开官方发布页中的 Full Changelog，查看与 0.169.0 的代码差异。

highlights: Added support for turning on Code Mode while agent teams are enabled; if you already turned it on, sessions with teams on now start in Code Mode
Added a startup warning when an --allowedTools, --disallowedTools or --tools value has an entry that doesn't look like a complete rule
Added a message explaining why MCP servers stop loading when an administrator adds managed-mcp.json during a session

guide.title: 支持在Agent团队启用时开启Code模式
guide.summary: 新增支持在Agent团队启用时开启Code模式；如果已开启，当前会话在团队启用时将自动进入Code模式。
guide.audience: Claude Code用户
guide.action: 在Agent团队启用时，通过设置开启Code模式
guide.basis: Added support for turning on Code Mode while agent teams are enabled; if you already turned it on, sessions with teams on now start in Code Mode

highlights: The opt-in terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs. Switch between them with the keyboard or mouse, and reopen saved local side chats after restarting Codex.
Search older tasks from the agent command center by name, prompt preview, or working directory.
Turn on Collapse turn details in the full-screen transcript to fold completed activity beneath each prompt while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable.

guide.title: 支持多标签侧边聊天窗口
guide.summary: 这项功能需手动启用。终端工作区支持多个侧边聊天标签。可通过键盘或鼠标在它们之间切换，并在重启后重新打开保存的本地侧边聊天。
guide.audience: Codex CLI 用户
guide.action: 切换侧边聊天标签：使用键盘或鼠标在多个侧边聊天标签之间切换。
guide.basis: The opt-in terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs. Switch between them with the keyboard or mouse, and reopen saved local side chats after restarting Codex.

highlights: Browse model providers under Sessions → Model providers and choose the default for new chats.
Enable features.tui_workspace to view a side conversation beside the main chat. Drag the divider to resize the panes or press leader z to zoom the focused pane.
Attach recordings when using an audio-capable model. Codex skips confirmed rejected recordings on later turns and uses clip duration to keep more short recordings in context.

guide.title: 可以为新会话选择默认模型提供商
guide.summary: Codex CLI 的会话菜单增加了模型提供商列表，可以指定新聊天默认使用哪家提供商。
guide.audience: 需要切换模型提供商的 Codex CLI 用户。
guide.action: 进入 Sessions → Model providers，选择新聊天要使用的默认提供商。
guide.basis: Browse model providers under Sessions → Model providers and choose the default for new chats.

highlights: 发布全家桶应用 API

guide.title: 把联网搜索和文件输入接入自己的应用
guide.summary: deepseek-flash 开放联网搜索、文件输入和链接阅读，工具调用由服务端处理。
guide.audience: 通过 Messages、Responses 或 Chat Completions 接入 deepseek-flash 的开发者。
guide.action: 在请求中启用 deepseek_web_search，再提一个需要联网的问题。开启其他工具的方式可在原文的指南中查看。

highlights: Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines is a 26B parameter model with 5.4B active.
ollama launch claude supports Claude Code's deferred tool loading, so MCP tools are loaded when needed instead of all at
Ollama on Apple silicon now serves multiple requests at once.
ollama launch opencode sets thinking options from the model's metadata

guide.title: 用 Ollama 在本地运行 Inkling 2 Mini
guide.summary: Thinking Machines 的 Inkling 2 Mini 支持文本、图片和工具调用。Ollama 的发布说明称，该模型在 Mac 上约需 20 GB 内存。
guide.audience: 希望在本地试用 Inkling 2 Mini 的 Ollama 用户。
guide.action: 在终端运行 ollama run inkling-2-mini，首次使用时等待模型下载。

highlights: Ripple Preview from Ricursive Intelligence is a 65B dense model built for agentic coding.
Qwen3.8 Flash Next uses about 27 GiB less memory on Apple silicon
ollama launch claude always routes Claude Code to the selected model
ollama launch explains when a cloud model has been retired

guide.title: Ollama 加入编程模型 Ripple Preview
guide.summary: Ricursive Intelligence 的 Ripple Preview 是面向编程任务的 65B 稠密模型，已支持通过 Ollama 运行。
guide.audience: 打算用 Ollama 试用 Ripple Preview 的开发者。
guide.action: 在终端运行 ollama run ripple-preview。

highlights: Xiaomi MiMo's mimo-v2.6, a 9B model built for code and agent workflows, is now supported in Ollama.

guide.title: 在 Ollama 中运行小米 MiMo V2.6
guide.summary: Ollama 新增对小米 MiMo V2.6 的支持。这是一个面向编程与智能体工作流的 9B 模型。
guide.audience: 想在本机试用 MiMo V2.6 的 Ollama 用户。
guide.action: 在终端运行 ollama run mimo-v2.6。

highlights: ollama launch claude now applies the model's output token limit for Claude Code, so cloud models no longer run into the 128k default cap
Cloud web search responses on /api/chat are now decoded correctly, including compressed responses
OpenAI-compatible endpoints no longer override a model's packaged sampler defaults — clients that send no temperature/top_p get the model's own values instead of 1.0, matching /api/chat

guide.title: Claude Code 模型现在应用输出令牌限制
guide.summary: Ollama 的 claude now 功能现在会应用模型的输出令牌限制，因此云模型不再受默认 128k 的限制。
guide.audience: Ollama 用户
guide.action: 启用 claude now 功能以应用 Claude Code 模型的输出令牌限制
guide.basis: ollama launch claude now applies the model's output token limit for Claude Code, so cloud models no longer run into the 128k default cap

highlights: Liquid AI's LFM3 models, including text-to-speech in lfm3-audio and lfm3-omni, now run on Linux and Windows as well as Apple silicon.

guide.action: 在 Linux、Windows 或 Apple Silicon 上运行 LFM3 模型，包括 lfm3-audio 和 lfm3-omni 的文本转语音功能。
